introHtml: Custom 7 oz wine glasses are ideal for wine tastings, hotel amenities, or gift sets where portion control and elegance matter. This smaller capacity suits sampling pours or dessert wines, and offers a compact canvas for your logo. Choose from stemless or stemmed styles, and decorate with screen printing or etching for a polished look that stands out.
